gaps.valueSet: SIL-R2 silica finding in lung tissue
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, so the H&E/PAS-test plus Lung Tissue specimen plus Silica finding alternative is omitted; the same-observation silicosis-coded result alternatives remain modeled

gaps.valueSet: SIL-R3 chest imaging consistent with silicosis
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the imaging result findings not implementable because EHR findings and impressions are narrative rather than coded; the numbered rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: SIL-R5 occupational exposure plus sarcoidosis or granulomatous lung disease
gaps.reason: the four industry/occupation value sets are local to RCKMS and unavailable in VSAC, and SEM_V1 has no industry or occupation evidence; the required exposure criterion cannot be modeled, so the numbered rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: SIL-R6 occupational exposure plus granulomatous histopathology
gaps.reason: the required industry/occupation evidence is unavailable, SEM_V1 cannot enforce the required lung-tissue specimen, and the alternative granulomatous-lung-disease result value sets have no codes; the numbered rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: SIL-R7 occupational exposure plus qualifying chest imaging
gaps.reason: the required industry/occupation evidence is unavailable and the source marks the coded imaging findings not implementable; the numbered rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: SIL-R8 classifiable parenchymal abnormalities interpreted by a certified B-reader
gaps.reason: the source marks both narrative imaging interpretation and B-reader certification not implementable; SEM_V1 has neither evidence type, so the numbered rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Laboratory, workers-compensation, and vital-record reporter types
gaps.reason: the source snapshot marks these reporter types unavailable in RCKMS; provider/facility rules with equivalent clinical or laboratory evidence remain modeled, while SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
